text: Play 3. Unlock Epic. 🎁 Your next three games come with a reveal. Join the quest on Home, then complete 3 free AI games with at least 10 moves per side. Win, lose or draw: all count. Open your free Epic Mystery Box on Home. Inside: 250 XP (60%), a 1.5× XP boost for 24 hours (30%), or a gold profile border (10%). Already own the border? Receive 250 XP instead. An active stronger boost is preserved and extended. One box per account. Games count only after joining. No deadline, deposit or purchase. Virtual in-app rewards with no cash value; no TON or Telegram Gifts. Tap below, find the quest on Home, and join.
